Δ(0)=a−b and the bound |s|²≤a+b for Re s≥0 prevent extra roots/zero crossings; s’(0)=−3b/4 proves initial stability. value.rationale: The equal two-tap synaptic kernel is a natural admissible positive discrete distribution in a contemporary theta-neuron delay framework but violates the previously exploited nonvanishing-transform assumption. Its Fourier cancellation yields a stabilizing second window for every a>b>0, unlike a mean-matched single atom throughout the nontrivial wedge 5a/13<b<a. Sharp all-parameter thresholds and a realizable population equilibrium reveal a structural effect of synaptic-delay heterogeneity, not a routine parameter substitution or small numeric improvement.
